test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, TRIM is written as GEVZ and FOCUS is written as SBPHF. How will UNIVERSITY be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d26a4107141c8988092be3a6f971de10fd85269bdcee88518465cc72c114f65.png] 

Given: TRIM is written as GEVZ and FOCUS is written as SBPHF.

The logic followed here is: 

**Adding 13 to the positional values **of the given letters, as shown below,

 
• TRIM is written as GEVZ.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca170d56e3f389a79aca80835b7b92559b82d6338ca65b809a8b35a2ed253ed9.png] 

And,

 
• FOCUS is written as SBPHF.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6e8dfa195a7570f381fa17a96755581f09b077beb9e23c7d2d58057c4720259.png] 

Similarly, 

 
• UNIVERSITY is coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1d7fae690009292557e412dbcdd89160853a0a417c8d48e5a52168b411f30ff.png] 

Hence, **HAVIREFVGL **is the correct answer.
